title: Test the purchase against the promise
text: A payment can succeed while the purchase is wrong. This local rehearsal shows COMRDY's workflow. No payment provider or AI model is called.

title: Turn instructions into constraints
text: Start with one clear purchase instruction. One blue Ocean Shell, medium, with a delivered budget of one hundred sixty dollars. No substitutions or subscriptions. Here the local fixture fills the contract. In the connected version, AI proposes these constraints. The buyer must review and confirm them.

title: A merchant we can test
text: Northpath Supply is a controlled test merchant. Its item costs one hundred twenty-nine dollars, shipping costs ten, and tax costs nine. The total is one hundred forty-eight dollars. The connected shopper prepares this cart through the browser. Buyer approval stays in PayPal's normal Sandbox flow. That external step still needs qualification.

title: Find the first divergence
text: The variant scenario deliberately changes the selected size while keeping the same price. Intent Lineage marks the first difference from the confirmed contract. The deterministic evaluator denies capture. In this local run, the payment status is explicitly simulated. In the connected workflow, denial requests a void and retrieves its status. An unresolved authorization remains unresolved until provider readback confirms the outcome.

title: One bounded recovery
text: Recovery restores the requested medium under the same confirmed contract. It cannot increase the budget or allow substitutions. The new attempt gets a different identifier. Connected execution requires fresh buyer approval and a fresh verification before capture. Here, the local result allows the corrected purchase. The comparison keeps the original failure beside the recovery. A second recovery request is rejected. This is a controlled correction, not a promise of general autonomous repair.

title: Keep the evidence inspectable
text: Recorded playback lets engineers inspect saved events without issuing payment requests. The report separates test verdicts from payment state and shows explicit sample sizes. Local tests cover duplicate commands and worker interruptions. These checks do not substitute for live PayPal qualification.

title: Ready for the real qualification pass
text: COMRDY is a transaction test lab for engineers building AI checkout. The second fault raises shipping above the delivered budget. Next comes real provider qualification, reviewed evidence, and the final film. This rehearsal is editable and reproducible. Test the purchase against the promise.
